plugins.name: adwhispr-ads
plugins.description: Competitor ad research and campaign launching. Use when you want to see what ads any brand is running, find the real competitors in a niche, research TikTok ads or Google keywords, or launch and manage ad campaigns from chat. Ingests any brand's entire live ad library from Meta and TikTok, surfaces the longest-running winners first, pulls real Google Keyword Planner data, and generates a competitive brief on any brand with a downloadable PDF. Launches complete campaigns on Meta, Google Search, Performance Max, TikTok, X (Twitter), and ChatGPT Ads from your own creative library. Every campaign is created paused with a preview-and-confirm step, so nothing spends until you explicitly resume it. Connects to AdWhispr's remote MCP server with a free OAuth sign-in; no API keys to manage, no hooks, and data flows only to AdWhispr's own API. Free tier included.

skills.name: campaign-review
skills.description: Review the user's own ad campaign performance and manage running campaigns. Use when the user asks how their campaigns are doing, wants spend, clicks, or conversion numbers, wants a weekly or Monday review, or wants to pause, resume, or change the budget of a campaign.

skills.name: clone-winning-ads
skills.description: Turn a competitor's proven ad into the user's own creative and get it live. Use when the user wants to copy, clone, remix, or adapt a winning ad they found, wants a script based on a competitor's TikTok ad, or wants to launch a creative they already have onto Meta or TikTok.
headings: Finished image and video creatives (made in the AdWhispr web app)

skills.name: competitor-research
skills.description: Find which brands in the user's niche are running ads RIGHT NOW and surface their proven winners. Use when the user asks who their competitors are, who has the best ads in their space, what ads a specific brand runs, or wants winning ad examples for any product or niche. Also use when the user names a competitor and wants their ads analyzed.
headings: Competitor ad research with verified data
